idea-plugin.name: Petabytes
idea-plugin.description:
Petabytes — small companions with a big appetite

A pet swims up and down the right edge of your editor, out of the way of your code, and reacts to what you do. Pick a sea creature from the Tide set, a pet from the Home set, a Snack, a pixel character from the Games set, or a desk Gadget: Shelly the sea turtle, Bloop the jellyfish, Inky the octopus, Pinchy the crab, Puff the pufferfish, Blue the whale, Clem the clownfish, Sandy the seahorse, Finn the shark, Splash the dolphin, Angie the angelfish Indigo the blue tang, Biscuit the golden retriever, Byte the cat, Clover the bunny Nugget the hamster, Patty the burger, Nori the sushi, Pepe the pizza, Sprinkles the donut, Tuesday the taco, Squish the slime, Boo the ghost, Sir Pix the knight, Bolt the robot, Lappy the laptop, Joy the controller, Java the coffee mug, Quackers the rubber duck, Spike the cactus, Floppy the floppy disk, Click the mouse, Beats the headphones or Post the sticky note.

  • Typing — swims faster
  • Saving — a happy loop and a few bubbles
  • New errors in the open file — looks worried, and hides when a lot appear at once (the octopus inks, the pufferfish puffs up)
  • Errors fixed — celebrates
  • Run configurations — spins when the app starts, cheers when a run passes, hides when it fails
  • AI assistants — notices when you open Copilot, AI Assistant, Junie and friends, and when a big block of code appears at once
  • The terminal — says hello when you open it
  • Branches and undo — notices a new branch, and a run of undos
  • Late nights, mornings, long sessions — says so, and suggests a stretch
  • Debugging — brings out a magnifying glass
  • Switching files — looks around
  • Idle for a few minutes — naps
  • Clicked / double-clicked — does a spin / shows hearts

Feed it: right-click the pet and choose Feed Pet, and a { }, [ ], ( ), < > or ; sinks down for it to eat. Every 20th { you type drops a crumb too.

The pet swims up and down a strip at the editor's right edge, beside the scrollbar; you can move it to the bottom edge instead. Drag it to where it should stay, or let it swim. It only takes clicks on itself, and when your cursor is right beside it, it fades and lets your clicks through. Right-click it to feed it, open Choose Pet… (a card for every pet, a tab per set), pick an edge, or hide it; Settings → Tools → Petabytes sets its position, size and name.

Also for VS Code, and as a Mac app whose pet walks along your Dock and reacts to your Mac. The Mac app is separate and can't see your code, so keep this plugin for that.

Free and open source (MIT): github.com/Chelayel/petabytes. If it makes you smile while you code, you can buy me a coffee.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.3.0 — Choose a Pet: a picker with a card for every pet and a tab per set, instead of a 34-item menu. Right-click the pet or use Tools → Petabytes → Choose Pet…, or the Choose… button in the settings.

1.2.0 — A new set, Gadgets: Lappy the laptop, Joy the controller, Java the coffee mug, Quackers the rubber duck (who helps you debug), Spike the cactus, Floppy the floppy disk, Click the mouse, Beats the headphones and Post the sticky note.

1.1.1 — With nothing to do, the pet wanders along its whole edge instead of staying near one spot.

1.1.0 — A new set, Games: original pixel-art characters. Squish the slime, Boo the ghost, Sir Pix the knight and Bolt the robot, who level up when you fix errors and say GAME OVER when tests fail.

1.0.0 — Petabytes 1.0. A new set, Snacks: Patty the burger, Nori the sushi, Pepe the pizza, Sprinkles the donut and Tuesday the taco. Also on the Mac: a pet that walks along your Dock.

0.4.0 — Tide Pets is now Petabytes, with pets beyond the sea: the new Home set brings Biscuit the golden retriever, Byte the cat, Clover the bunny and Nugget the hamster. Settings start fresh under the new name.

0.3.0 — The pet now swims up and down the editor's right edge, out of the way of your code (the bottom edge is still an option, in its menu or the settings). Three new pets: Splash the dolphin, Angie the angelfish and Indigo the blue tang.

0.2.1 — Fix: the pet could end up underneath the editor and disappear (its layer was set as a list position). New screenshot of the pet in IntelliJ IDEA.

0.2.0 — Eight new pets: Bloop the jellyfish, Inky the octopus, Pinchy the crab, Puff the pufferfish, Blue the whale, Clem the clownfish, Sandy the seahorse and Finn the shark. Feed your pet curly braces; it reacts to AI assistants, the terminal, runs, branches, undo sprees and the time of day. The pet now floats at the bottom of the editor instead of living in a tool window: drag it where you want it, or let it swim around; it fades out of the way of the line you're working on. Right-click it or use Tools → Petabytes to choose one; Settings → Tools → Petabytes for its size and name. New logo.

0.1.1 — First release on the Marketplace (0.1.0 was built but not uploaded).

0.1.0 — First release: Shelly the sea turtle.
